playpause.note: There is a large Play button as well as a small Play/Pause button in the row of media controls. The prompt only requests one playpause control.

prev.note: Button looks good and fits the theme.

next.note: Button looks good and fits the theme.

vol.note: The knob in the active state is identical to the idle state; the metal reflections and the small indicator did not rotate.

seek.note: The original silver handle is baked into the left edge of the track. Furthermore, the CSS track fill is a rectangular bar that awkwardly overlaps the rounded 3D groove.

shuffle.note: Toggle sprite replaces nicely and fits the slot.

notes: The Frutiger Aero aesthetic is beautifully executed with the water droplets, glossy highlights, and sky motifs.
Multiple layout and functional defects completely break the usability of the design.
Having duplicate play buttons creates confusion, and the slider track is very poorly masked.
improve: Remove the extra play/pause button in the top right to avoid duplicate media controls.
Ensure the volume knob is separated as an interactable sprite so it can rotate when adjusted.
Render the slider groove completely empty (no baked thumb) so the CSS thumb can travel freely.
Adjust the CSS clipping path on the slider track so the fill stays within the bounds of the 3D groove.
